first.text:
My mistake — it's not on your athlete page. The athlete page only mentions plate-pool in passing.

The link lives at the top of each of your routine pages. Open any of them — Monday's press, Saturday's bench, Sunday's deadlift, the hang, the circuit — and a few lines down you'll see **"Set up the home kit in plate-pool"**. Tap that once on your phone and your home kit is saved in the app; after that, the **"Load it in plate-pool"** links next to each lift will drop the right loading straight in.

If the routine pages aren't handy, the app itself is at https://joeuk89.github.io/plate-pool/ — but the kit setup link is the one you want first, so start from a routine page.
